data.title: 芙宁娜 · 深夜剧本案头创作
data.description: 午夜的剧团工作室只亮着一盏绿罩台灯，暖黄的光落在红木桌面与反复修改的剧本上。芙宁娜戴着贝雷帽，披深蓝开衫，一手压住手稿，另一手把羽毛笔杆的末端轻抵唇边，笔尖朝向墨水瓶。她没有急着落笔，而是盯着空白的一行，认真推敲下一句对白。
data.location: 剧团工作室实木书桌前
data.action: 坐在剧本桌前，一手压手稿，另一手将羽毛笔杆末端抵在唇边思考，笔尖远离嘴唇。
data.lighting: warm light from a green-shaded desk lamp
data.camera: medium shot, slightly high angle, manuscript and face visible
data.promptProse: Furina considers a blank line at the mahogany script desk, pressing revised pages flat with one hand while the blunt quill end touches her lips. Its inked nib points away toward the inkwell. From slightly above, the medium view shows her navy cardigan, beret and thoughtful face. The green-shaded lamp warms the paper and her cheek, casting the quill's narrow shadow across the otherwise dark midnight desk.
